definitions.explanation: A person who creates paintings as a profession or vocation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{画家|がか}だ。
{画家|がか}を{目指|めざ}している。
examples.english: I'm aiming to become a painter.

examples.japanese: この{画家|がか}の{作品|さくひん}は{人気|にんき}がある。

notes:
{画家|がか} specifically refers to painters who create visual art.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- {画|が} (picture, painting) + {家|か} (professional, -ist)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {画家|がか}になる (to become a painter)
- {画家|がか}を{目指|めざ}す (to aim to be a painter)
- 〜{派|は}の{画家|がか} (painter of the ~ school)

TYPES:
- {油絵|あぶらえ}{画家|がか} (oil painter)
- {水彩|すいさい}{画家|がか} (watercolor painter)
- {風景|ふうけい}{画家|がか} (landscape painter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アーティスト: artist (broader, loanword)
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}: artist (broader)
- {絵描|えか}き: painter (informal)
